_provenance.upstream_operation: AES-CBC MCT (AESAVS section 6.4), 100 outer iterations x 1000 inner blocks
_provenance.local_operation: per outer iteration: C_CreateObject(AES key = resultsArray key), C_EncryptInit/C_DecryptInit(CKM_AES_CBC, IV), 1000 chained single-block C_EncryptUpdate/C_DecryptUpdate in one multi-part operation (the engine supplies the CBC chaining), C_*Final; the last output byte-compared to resultsArray ct/pt, then the next key / IV / input derived per AESAVS 6.4 from the engine outputs
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. The single MCT case of each of the six (direction x key length) MCT groups, with the full 100-entry resultsArray.
_provenance.retained_fields: group: tgId, testType, direction, keyLen; case: tcId, key, iv, pt|ct, resultsArray (all 100 key/iv/pt/ct)
_provenance.construction_note: The AESAVS 6.4 outer loop (key XOR the last key-length bits of the last outputs, IV = last output, next input = second-to-last output) was reproduced for all 100 outer iterations of the six upstream cases with an independent AES (Python cryptography) before the subset was cut.
